title: 277 and 279 Hazel St (Z-25-16, OPA-69)
body:
Application to amend zoning for 277 and 279 Hazel St
Changes to the Official Plan and the Zoning Bylaw for this location are required before a permit can be issued. This means that they submit an application that is reviewed by city planners and other agencies plus city council before anything can be built.
Rajadurai Rajamohan, Luxmiepriya Rajamohan, and Veerasingam Sasikumar are proposing a new residential building at 277, 279 Hazel Street. The plan is for a 6-storey building containing 40 units, 4 vehicle parking spaces, and 18 bicycle parking spaces.
Official Plan changes include:
allowing a density up to 381 bedrooms per hectare
Zoning By-law changes include:
lift the Holding to facilitate the development
reduce the minimum required side yard setback to 2 m
reduce the minimum required rear yard setback to 6.3 m
reduce the required minimum height of the first storey to 3.7 m
allow an increased maximum density of 381 bedrooms per hectare
View the documents submitted by the development company under supporting documents on this page for more details and drawings.
Building height, units, housing types
Building height: 6 storeys, 20 m
Number of units: 40
Number of bedrooms: 40 bedrooms
Unit sizes: mix of studio and one bedroom
Parking
Parking: 4
Bicycle parking: 18
You can provide feedback to the planning department, and it will be shared with the council, or ask a question to learn more about this application.
Images are provided by the applicant and may not reflect the final design approved by the planning division.
